name: Quitting
overview: Scripture encourages believers to persevere in doing good without growing weary, promising a harvest in due time if they do not give up, as seen in Galatians 6:9. The Christian life is likened to a race that requires patience and the laying aside of sin and distractions, according to Hebrews 12:1. Strength to endure and overcome challenges comes through Christ, who empowers believers to face all circumstances, as affirmed in Philippians 4:13.
